div.l: White was his berde as is þe daysy
Of his complexyoun̄ he was sangweyn̄
Well loued by the morow a soppe in wyne
To lyue in delyte euer was his won̄e
For he was Epyourues own̄ son̄
That helde opynyon̄ that pleyn̄ delyte
Was veray felicite parfyte
An householder and þat a gret was he
Seynte Iulyan̄ was he in his cuntre
Hys brede his ale was allwey after one
A Better envyned man̄ was nowher͗ none
Withoute Bakemete was neủer his house
Of Fysche of Flesche and þat so plenteous
Hit sewed in his house of mete and drynke
Of alle deyntees þat men̄ kowde thynke
After the sondry sesoıı̄uns of the yere
So chaunged he his mete ⁊and his soper͗
Full many a Fatte partrych had he in mewe
And many a Breme and many a luse in stewe
Wo was his coke but his sause were
Poynan̄t and scharp̄e and redy all his ger͗
Hys tabull dorman̄t in his halle allewey
Stode redy keủered all þe longe day
At Sessyon̄s þer was he lord and sire
Full ofte tymes was he knyght of the schir͗
An Anelas and a Gypser all of sylke
Henge at his gurdul as white as mylke
A Schiref had he be and a comptoure
Was nowher͗ such a worthy vauasour͗
¶ An haburdascher and a carpenter
A webbe a dyer and a Tapeser͗
And they wer͗ clothed in o lyuere
Of a solempne and a grete fraternyte
Full fressche and newe her gere a pyked was
